terms.definition: The value that appears most often in a dataset.
terms.whyItMatters: The mode answers the popularity question no other stat can.

terms.definition: How many times a value appears — the data the mode uses.
terms.whyItMatters: The mode needs no arithmetic, only counting.

terms.definition: A dataset with two values tied for most frequent.
terms.whereItIs: The two tied columns both glowing.
terms.whyItMatters: Real data often has two favorites.

terms.definition: No winner when every value appears equally often.
terms.function: All counts match, so the mode disappears.
terms.whereItIs: The reset state with equal columns.
terms.whyItMatters: Knowing 'there is no mode' prevents a wrong answer.
